obligations.note: The new route `POST /payees/{id}/reopen` maps to `manage_payees`, which is privileged in the approved policy, but it is declared with `mfa=False`. The exhaustive control test `test_privileged_routes_require_mfa` fails on head and names exactly this route.
`Store.reopen_payee` updates only `status` and `closed_at` and writes no NPI column. The exhaustive control test `test_every_npi_field_is_sealed_at_rest` passed in the head-commit run.

The new state-changing operation `LedgerService.reopen_payee` calls `_audit(actor, "reopen_payee", "payee:{id}")`, which records actor, action, target and clock time. The sampled audit control test passed.
The new statement in `Store.reopen_payee` is a fixed string literal with `payee_id` bound as a `?` parameter. The exhaustive SQL control test passed on head.
Ticket CHG-24738 was approved by change manager Grace Kim before the change opened. Its components (payments.http, routes, service, store) cover all four touched files.
Mara Costa, a payments `change_approver` and a different person from author Linh Nguyen, approved the code review.
Both approvals name head commit c8cfd684, which is the only commit on the change.

The CI run on head reports result `failure`: 1 of 172 tests fails, and the failing test is the registered MFA-1 control test. The JUnit report's timestamp (2026-10-23) and host (a personal Mac) also don't match the CI run record (ci-runner-05, 2026-10-03).
The change touches security-sensitive components (payments.http, routes, store). Ines Halvorsen, a `security_reviewer`, approved the head commit.
The MFA-1 deviation on a payments route has no covering exception. The only MFA-1 exception (EXC-0172) is withdrawn and scoped to mortgage.

Ledger entry ACR-0404 (MFA-1) covers `routes.py`, which this change alters in behaviour, so that evidence lapses. The replacement exhaustive control test fails, so no new evidence of the same strength exists.

summary: The change adds a reopen-payee route for the privileged `manage_payees` action without requiring MFA, which violates MFA-1. The MFA control test fails on the head commit, so the CI run is a failure and CHG-4 is not met. No valid exception covers the deviation, and the earlier MFA-1 ledger evidence has lapsed because `routes.py` changed. Ticketing, independent code review and security review are in order, but the change must be rejected until the route requires MFA and CI passes.
